changes.reason: run() hashed source inputs and manifests before taking the capture read guard, so a writer could publish files during verification. Only the study-directory declaration is now checked before the locks; all source input hashing and reading happens while they are held. A test with a held lock and a changed input now meets the lock first; on the previous code it met the input mismatch first.
A corrupt or non-SQLite lock file raised sqlite3.DatabaseError, crashing preflight. Preflight now reports it as blocking, and a run refuses with AuditError before any attempt.
